content: soroban-sdk testutils: env.ledger().with_mut(|li| { li.sequence_number = value; }) advances ledger sequence; env.storage().persistent().get_ttl(&key) / extend_ttl(&key, threshold, extension) inspect and bump TTL (get_ttl test-only, SDK v21+).
